ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: Column conforming to DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllocationHandling attribute MUST adhere to the following requirements:

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: A FOCUS dataset MUST include the following columns when the data generator supports data generator-calculated split cost allocation: AllocatedMethodId, AllocatedResourceId, AllocatedResourceName, AllocatedTags.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: A FOCUS dataset SHOULD include the following column when the data generator supports data generator-calculated split cost allocation: AllocatedMethodDetails.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: Allocated charge records in a FOCUS dataset MUST sum up to the origin charge record for all aggregatable metric columns.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: For each allocated charge records in a FOCUS dataset, all dimension columns and non-aggregatable metric columns MUST match the values of the origin charge record.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: Allocated charge records MUST include the same keys and values present in the Tags column for the origin charge.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: Allocated charge records MUST satisfy normative requirements for all columns.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: The method used for allocating origin charges to create allocated charges MUST be documented by the data generator and accessible to practitioners.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: A FOCUS dataset MAY contain records for concepts not related to resource usage, if documented in the split cost allocation method.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: A FOCUS dataset MAY contain records for the unused or unallocated usage from the origin charge as separate allocated charges, if it aligns to the data generator's documented allocation method.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: Allocated charge records MAY contain apportioned costs for the unused or unallocated usage from the origin charge, if it aligns to the data generator's documented allocation method.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: Split cost allocation is RECOMMENDED to be applied to charges on an opt-in basis.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: FOCUS dataset column representing a dimension MUST match the corresponding value in the origin charge when present in an allocated charge.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: FOCUS dataset column representing a non-summable metric (e.g., unit prices) MUST match the corresponding value in the origin charge when present in an allocated charge.

ATT-DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllo.EntityName: Data Generator Calculated Split Cost Allocation Handling

ValidationCriteria.MustSatisfy: The sum of FOCUS dataset column across allocated charges MUST match the FOCUS dataset column in the corresponding origin charge when the FOCUS dataset column represents a summable metric (e.g., costs and quantities).
